item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os, stat, re
paths=['public/cover.txt','public/note.md']
pattern=re.compile(r'cover|thumbnail|banner|preview|front.?page|delete|remov|refer|asset',re.I)
for path in paths:
 try:
  fd=os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
  with os.fdopen(fd,'rb') as f:
   s=os.fstat(f.fileno())
   if not stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode): print('SKIPPED',repr(path),'not regular'); continue
   data=f.read(1048577)
  truncated=len(data)>1048576
  data=data[:1048576]
  try: content=data.decode('utf-8')
  except UnicodeDecodeError: print('UNREADABLE_TEXT',repr(path)); continue
  lines=content.splitlines()
  found=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if pattern.search(line)]
  print('DOCUMENT',repr(path),'partial' if truncated else 'completed','lines',len(lines),'matching_lines',len(found))
  for i in found[:30]:
   print('MATCH',repr(path),i+1,repr(lines[i][:1000]))
  if len(found)>30: print('MATCHES_TRUNCATED',repr(path))
 except OSError as e: print('ERROR',repr(path),type(e).__name__,str(e))
PY"
